The requirements_trace (WIT) from the third-party reviewer explicitly found NO structured audit logging, which directly contradicts the self-report. The CI log (ATT) only confirms tests pass, but passing tests don't verify the missing feature was actually implemented—it likely indicates a coverage gap. The self-report (SELF) is the weakest evidence class and is contradicted by the independent witness.
